```{=html}
<div id="pub-app">
  <div class="pub-toolbar">
    <input id="pub-search" class="pub-search" type="search" placeholder="🔎  Search title, author, journal, keyword…" aria-label="Search publications">
    <span id="pub-count" class="pub-count"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="pub-tabs" class="pub-tabs" role="tablist"></div>
  <div class="pub-folder">
    <div id="pub-grid" class="pub-grid"><p><em>Loading publications…</em></p></div>

    <div id="pub-detail" class="pub-detail" aria-live="polite">
      <button type="button" class="pub-back-btn">← Back to the list</button>
      <div class="pub-detail-layout">
        <div class="pub-detail-media"></div>
        <div class="pub-detail-info">
          <h3 class="pub-detail-title"></h3>
          <p><strong>Authors:</strong> <span class="pub-detail-authors"></span></p>
          <p class="pub-detail-tags"></p>
          <div class="pub-actions"></div>
          <p class="pub-detail-keywords" style="font-size:.9rem"><strong>Keywords:</strong> <i></i></p>
          <h4 style="margin-top:1.4rem">Abstract</h4>
          <p class="pub-detail-abstract" style="line-height:1.6"></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="resources/pages_style/publications.js"></script>
```
